name: clockworacle
description: Clockwork Oracle mod for Sunless Sea

scripts.build: npm run build-ui && npm run build-mod
scripts.build-ui: npm run compilecss && npm run compilejs && npm run compilehtml
scripts.release: npm run release-ui && npm run release-mod
scripts.release-ui: rimraf release/modtools.zip && cd build && zip-a-folder modtools ../release/modtools.zip -e "game-data/json/*.json" -e "game-data/icons/*.png" -e "game-data/icons/*.db"
scripts.release-mod: rimraf release/clockworacle-mod.zip && cd build && zip-a-folder clockworacle ../release/clockworacle-mod.zip -d clockworacle
